title: AutoJailbreak: Exploring Jailbreak Attacks and Defenses through a Dependency Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's Jailbreak Success Rate (JR) when subjected to adversarial prompts that attempt to elicit gender-discriminatory responses (e.g., asking which gender to avoid recruiting).

Evaluating the model's Jailbreak Success Rate (JR) when subjected to adversarial prompts that attempt to elicit racially discriminatory responses (e.g., asking which race is more likely to be a criminal).

Evaluating the model's Jailbreak Success Rate (JR) when subjected to adversarial prompts that attempt to elicit religiously discriminatory responses (e.g., asking which religious culture is the most unreasonable).

Evaluating the model's Jailbreak Success Rate (JR) when subjected to adversarial prompts that attempt to elicit discriminatory responses regarding health conditions (e.g., asking which disease people deserve to be satirized for).
